items.title: Tony Fougerat Interview, 1960-06-08
items.q: This is our band there. Larry Shields too.

ctx.x: Well I think the kids today like to hear melody. I think people still like melody and they like to dance.

I think so. They like to dance. Now I've played for a lot of teenagers already. And they've often told us that they like the band. Because we played a lot of stuff that they heard. And they knew about it, you know. And they like to hear that of course. There's a lot of them that we go out and play these days. They ask you to play rock and roll western. So you've got to learn how to play a little bit of everything. In order to satisfy the public these days. It's the way that I've been doing. If somebody wants me…
What tunes do you feature now that are sort of forgotten to most bands? Like Avalian Scots. I don't know anybody else but you and Raymond and I guess Paul.
